# PromptBill

> LLM API Cost Calculator, Semantic Leaderboard, Prompt Caching & Batch API Estimator, Context-Tiered Pricing Checker, and Multi-Host / Router Comparison at https://promptbill.online.

## Core Calculators & Tools
- [LLM Cost & Margin Workspace](https://promptbill.online/): Interactive 30-day cost calculator with prompt cache write/read modeling, batch API discounts, context-tier thresholds, and hosting comparisons.
- [All Models Directory](https://promptbill.online/models): Full catalog of tracked models with input, cached read, cache write, output pricing, context windows, and throughput.
- [Head-to-Head Model Comparisons](https://promptbill.online/compare): Side-by-side LLM comparisons across benchmarks, speed, and token pricing.
- [API Pricing Reference](https://promptbill.online/pricing): Token pricing comparison across providers and tiers.
- [Routing Simulator](https://promptbill.online/tools/routing-simulator): Estimate savings from routing simple traffic to economy models and escalating complex tasks to flagship models.
- [Token Counter](https://promptbill.online/tools/token-counter): Estimate prompt token counts across providers.
- [LLM Selector](https://promptbill.online/tools/llm-selector): Match models to coding, reasoning, RAG, or high-throughput workloads.

## Billing Nuances & Engineering Guides
- [Best LLMs for Coding](https://promptbill.online/best-llms-for-coding): Coding benchmark rankings and token cost trade-offs.
- [Best Open-Weight LLMs](https://promptbill.online/best-open-weight-llms): Compare open-weight models across official APIs, inference clouds (Together, Fireworks, Groq, AWS Bedrock), and routers.
- [Cheapest LLMs for Classification](https://promptbill.online/cheapest-llms-for-classification): Low-cost models for high-volume classification and extraction.
- [Fastest LLMs (Tokens/sec)](https://promptbill.online/fastest-llms-tokens-per-second): Throughput leaders for low-latency and streaming workloads.
- [Methodology](https://promptbill.online/methodology): Scoring methodology, pricing verification, prompt caching, batch discounts, and long-context pricing rules.
